title: World War II: A Global Conflict
text: World War II (1939–1945) was the deadliest conflict in human history, involving more than 30 countries and resulting in an estimated 70–85 million deaths. It began with Germany's invasion of Poland on September 1, 1939, prompting declarations of war by Britain and France. Major theaters included Europe, the Pacific, North Africa, and Asia. The Holocaust, the systematic genocide of six million Jews by Nazi Germany along with millions of others, remains one of history's greatest atrocities. The war ended in Europe with Germany's surrender on May 8, 1945 (V-E Day), and in the Pacific after the United States dropped atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, leading to Japan's surrender on September 2, 1945.
